findings.title: A real backend-neutral Razor boundary now exists
findings.decision: Retain the project and build the Simple Chat UI on it; do not merge it back into AgentFramework.Components.

findings.title: Agent components are thin adapters over neutral presentation contracts
findings.decision: Preserve the adapter direction and existing public Agent component contracts.

findings.title: Committed closure records broad component and targeted browser parity
findings.decision: Use as historical evidence, then reconcile its missing artifact paths in SB01.

findings.title: User manually confirmed settings changes and Project Structure Agent chat still work
findings.decision: Record as user-supplied regression evidence; do not infer untested floating, cancellation, or streaming cases.

findings.title: Governed proof paths are ignored and absent while closure/checksums cite them
findings.decision: Reconcile and commit bounded proof or downgrade/remove unsupported claims before CP0.

findings.title: Several allegedly immutable presentation records retain caller-owned list instances
findings.decision: Copy and validate collections at construction boundaries.

findings.title: ConversationPresentationKey validates nonblank only
findings.decision: Normalize, bound, and prove opaque key round-trips without encoding backend authority.

findings.title: Pending message rendering is hard-coded as a black User Sending bubble
findings.decision: Introduce role-driven transient messages before consuming response deltas.

findings.title: Markdown disables raw HTML but has no explicit safe URI-scheme policy
findings.decision: Add a tested safe-link/image policy before rendering broader untrusted LLM output.

findings.title: ConversationActiveList still owns Agent-shaped Open and Stop actions
findings.decision: Use declared generic actions and map Agent Open/Stop through its adapter.

findings.title: Conversation projections expose HasActiveTurn but not the operation identity needed to reconnect
findings.decision: Add ActiveOperationId and prove exact profile-fenced ownership.

findings.title: A reusable application-level durable event stream session already exists
findings.decision: Use it directly from server-side UI through a UI adapter; do not loop back through HTTP.

findings.title: No Simple Chat Razor module, route, navigation, or component assembly is registered
findings.decision: Create a dedicated UI project after CP1.

findings.title: The application shell still owns an Agent-only floating host and launcher label
findings.decision: Introduce a neutral contributor-based floating shell only after the main Simple Chat page passes CP2.

findings.title: API policies exist, but direct in-process UI calls need equivalent read/manage/execute authorization gates
findings.decision: Add a typed UI authorization facade; do not assume page visibility grants all actions.

findings.title: Simple Chats still have no typed project-context aggregate or source adapter
findings.decision: Leave the existing ContextActions slot unused and plan Project Structure context as a later bundle.

findings.title: The predecessor Stable closure recorded three unrelated LLM Chat integration failures
findings.decision: Classify exact current cases without repeatedly running Stable; one final Stable gate remains authorized in SB12.
